`````rust
//! 密钥槽（ADR 0006 §3 / §15）：wrap/unwrap 根密钥、改口令纯逻辑。
//!
//! **wire 类型来自 `menghunote-sync-proto`**：`SlotDescriptorV1`、`Kind`、`Kdf`、
//! `Argon2idParams` 的 CDE 编码/解码/边界校验都在 proto；本模块只加：
//!
//! - **策略校验**：kind 与 kdf 必须匹配、Argon2 参数在读者区间内（**调用 Argon2 之前**）；
//! - KEK 派生（HKDF 域来自 proto 常量）；
//! - 槽体 AEAD：`nonce(24B) || XChaCha20-Poly1305(K_wrap, AAD, RootSecretV1 CDE)`；
//! - 改口令的 CAS 纯逻辑。
//!
//! `AAD` 由**信封层**构造（`menghunote-sync-proto::EnvelopeHeader::aad`，ADR §2：
//! `b"MN/e2e/v1\0" || header[0..196] || BE32(desc_len) || desc`）。信封 header 里的
//! `this_plaintext_len` 决定 AAD，所以 [`SlotAad`] 会收到明文长度；加密侧用根 CDE 的长度，
//! 解密侧用 `ciphertext_len - TAG_LEN`（两者必须一致，这正是 AEAD 认证的一部分）。

use crate::domain;
use crate::error::SyncError;
use crate::kdf;
use crate::keys::{RootSecretV1, WrapKey};
use crate::random::RandomSource;
use crate::recovery::{self, RecoverySeed};
use chacha20poly1305::aead::{Aead, KeyInit, Payload};
use chacha20poly1305::{XChaCha20Poly1305, XNonce};
use menghunote_sync_proto::{Kdf, SlotDescriptorV1, SlotKind};
use sha2::{Digest, Sha256};
use zeroize::Zeroizing;

/// 槽协议版本（v1 = 1，与 proto 的 `PROTOCOL_VERSION` 一致）。
pub const PROTOCOL_VERSION: u16 = 1;
/// 唯一的 wrap 套件：XChaCha20-Poly1305（`cipher_suite = 1`，ADR §2）。
pub const WRAP_SUITE_XCHACHA20_POLY1305: u16 = 1;
/// XChaCha20-Poly1305 nonce 长度（ADR §2：header 内 24B CSPRNG nonce）。
pub const NONCE_LEN: usize = 24;
/// Poly1305 tag 长度。
pub const TAG_LEN: usize = 16;

fn kind_label(kind: SlotKind) -> &'static str {
    match kind {
        SlotKind::Password => "password",
        SlotKind::Recovery => "recovery",
    }
}

/// 槽描述的策略校验（proto 校验之后还要过这一层）。
///
/// proto 的 `SlotDescriptorV1::validate` 只查版本/wrap_suite/key_epoch>0，且在
/// `encode/to_cde` 时才查 Argon2 参数；本函数补上 **kind ↔ kdf 一致性** 与
/// **KDF 之前的 Argon2 范围闸门**，供本地构造的描述在派生密钥前调用。
pub fn validate_slot_descriptor(descriptor: &SlotDescriptorV1) -> Result<(), SyncError> {
    descriptor.validate()?;
    if descriptor.created_at > i64::MAX as u64 {
        return Err(SyncError::Descriptor("created_at 超过 i64::MAX"));
    }
    if descriptor.manager_rev > i64::MAX as u64 {
        return Err(SyncError::Descriptor("manager_rev 超过 i64::MAX"));
    }
    match (&descriptor.kind, &descriptor.kdf) {
        (SlotKind::Password, Kdf::Argon2id(params)) => {
            kdf::validate_argon2id_params(params)?;
        }
        (SlotKind::Recovery, Kdf::RecoveryHkdf) => {}
        (SlotKind::Password, Kdf::RecoveryHkdf) => {
            return Err(SyncError::SlotKind {
                expected: "password/argon2id",
                actual: "password/recovery-hkdf",
            })
        }
        (SlotKind::Recovery, Kdf::Argon2id(_)) => {
            return Err(SyncError::SlotKind {
                expected: "recovery/hkdf",
                actual: "recovery/argon2id",
            })
        }
    }
    Ok(())
}

/// `context_hash = SHA256(CDE(descriptor))`（ADR §2：KEY_SLOT header 的 `context_hash`）。
pub fn context_hash(descriptor: &SlotDescriptorV1) -> Result<[u8; 32], SyncError> {
    let digest = Sha256::digest(descriptor.encode()?);
    let mut out = [0u8; 32];
    out.copy_from_slice(&digest);
    Ok(out)
}

/// 口令槽：派生 `K_password_wrap = HKDF(Argon2id(password), vault_id,
/// b"MN/v1/password-wrap\0" || slot_id, 32)`（ADR §3）。
///
/// 口令与 Argon2 参数都**先校验**，越界时不会执行 Argon2。
pub fn password_wrap_key(
    descriptor: &SlotDescriptorV1,
    password: &[u8],
) -> Result<WrapKey, SyncError> {
    validate_slot_descriptor(descriptor)?;
    if descriptor.kind != SlotKind::Password {
        return Err(SyncError::SlotKind {
            expected: "password",
            actual: kind_label(descriptor.kind),
        });
    }
    let params = match &descriptor.kdf {
        Kdf::Argon2id(params) => params,
        Kdf::RecoveryHkdf => {
            return Err(SyncError::SlotKind {
                expected: "argon2id",
                actual: "recovery-hkdf",
            })
        }
    };
    let material = kdf::argon2id_output(password, params)?;
    let info = domain::password_wrap_info(&descriptor.slot_id);
    let kek = kdf::hkdf32(material.expose_slice(), &descriptor.vault_id, &info)?;
    Ok(WrapKey::from_secret(kek))
}

/// 恢复槽：派生 `K_recovery_wrap = HKDF(R, vault_id,
/// b"MN/v1/recovery-wrap\0" || slot_id, 32)`（ADR §3）。
pub fn recovery_wrap_key(
    descriptor: &SlotDescriptorV1,
    seed: &RecoverySeed,
) -> Result<WrapKey, SyncError> {
    validate_slot_descriptor(descriptor)?;
    if descriptor.kind != SlotKind::Recovery {
        return Err(SyncError::SlotKind {
            expected: "recovery",
            actual: kind_label(descriptor.kind),
        });
    }
    if !matches!(descriptor.kdf, Kdf::RecoveryHkdf) {
        return Err(SyncError::SlotKind {
            expected: "recovery-hkdf",
            actual: "argon2id",
        });
    }
    recovery::recovery_wrap_key(seed, &descriptor.vault_id, &descriptor.slot_id)
}

/// 信封层提供的 AAD 构造器。
///
/// ADR §2：`AAD = b"MN/e2e/v1\0" || header[0..196] || BE32(descriptor_len) || descriptor`。
/// header 里的 `object_id`/`nonce`/`this_plaintext_len` 等只有信封层知道，所以由它来拼；
/// 本模块把"即将写入 header 的 nonce 与明文长度"回传给构造器，保证加解密两侧一致。
///
/// 真实调用方应当先用 proto 构造 `EnvelopeHeader`，再调用 `header.aad(&descriptor.encode()?)`。
pub trait SlotAad {
    /// 给定槽描述、nonce 与明文长度，返回完整 AAD 字节。
    fn aad(
        &self,
        descriptor: &SlotDescriptorV1,
        nonce: &[u8; NONCE_LEN],
        plaintext_len: usize,
    ) -> Result<Vec<u8>, SyncError>;
}

impl<F> SlotAad for F
where
    F: Fn(&SlotDescriptorV1, &[u8; NONCE_LEN], usize) -> Result<Vec<u8>, SyncError>,
{
    fn aad(
        &self,
        descriptor: &SlotDescriptorV1,
        nonce: &[u8; NONCE_LEN],
        plaintext_len: usize,
    ) -> Result<Vec<u8>, SyncError> {
        self(descriptor, nonce, plaintext_len)
    }
}

/// 槽体：`nonce || ciphertext || tag`（AEAD 输出已含 tag）。
#[derive(Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct WrappedRoot {
    /// 24B CSPRNG nonce（同时写进 MNE1 header）。
    pub nonce: [u8; NONCE_LEN],
    /// XChaCha20-Poly1305 密文（含 16B tag）。
    pub ciphertext: Vec<u8>,
}

impl WrappedRoot {
    /// 序列化为 `nonce || ciphertext`。
    #[must_use]
    pub fn to_bytes(&self) -> Vec<u8> {
        let mut out = Vec::with_capacity(NONCE_LEN + self.ciphertext.len());
        out.extend_from_slice(&self.nonce);
        out.extend_from_slice(&self.ciphertext);
        out
    }

    /// 从 `nonce || ciphertext` 解析（至少要有 nonce + tag）。
    pub fn from_bytes(bytes: &[u8]) -> Result<Self, SyncError> {
        if bytes.len() < NONCE_LEN + TAG_LEN {
            return Err(SyncError::Unwrap);
        }
        let mut nonce = [0u8; NONCE_LEN];
        nonce.copy_from_slice(&bytes[..NONCE_LEN]);
        Ok(Self {
            nonce,
            ciphertext: bytes[NONCE_LEN..].to_vec(),
        })
    }
}

/// 一个密钥槽：proto 的槽描述 + 被 KEK 封装的根。
#[derive(Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct KeySlotV1 {
    /// 槽描述（CDE 会进 AAD / context_hash）。
    pub descriptor: SlotDescriptorV1,
    /// 槽体。
    pub wrapped: WrappedRoot,
}

impl KeySlotV1 {
    /// 用口令槽封装根。
    pub fn wrap_password(
        descriptor: &SlotDescriptorV1,
        password: &[u8],
        root: &RootSecretV1,
        aad: &impl SlotAad,
        rng: &mut impl RandomSource,
    ) -> Result<Self, SyncError> {
        let kek = password_wrap_key(descriptor, password)?;
        Self::wrap_with_key(descriptor, &kek, root, aad, rng)
    }

    /// 用恢复槽封装根。
    pub fn wrap_recovery(
        descriptor: &SlotDescriptorV1,
        seed: &RecoverySeed,
        root: &RootSecretV1,
        aad: &impl SlotAad,
        rng: &mut impl RandomSource,
    ) -> Result<Self, SyncError> {
        let kek = recovery_wrap_key(descriptor, seed)?;
        Self::wrap_with_key(descriptor, &kek, root, aad, rng)
    }

    fn wrap_with_key(
        descriptor: &SlotDescriptorV1,
        kek: &WrapKey,
        root: &RootSecretV1,
        aad: &impl SlotAad,
        rng: &mut impl RandomSource,
    ) -> Result<Self, SyncError> {
        validate_slot_descriptor(descriptor)?;
        if descriptor.vault_id != root.vault_id || descriptor.key_epoch != root.key_epoch {
            return Err(SyncError::Descriptor("槽描述与根归属（vault/epoch）不一致"));
        }
        let plaintext = Zeroizing::new(root.encode()?);
        let nonce = crate::random::array::<NONCE_LEN>(rng)?;
        let aad_bytes = aad.aad(descriptor, &nonce, plaintext.len())?;
        let cipher =
            XChaCha20Poly1305::new_from_slice(kek.expose()).map_err(|_| SyncError::Unwrap)?;
        let ciphertext = cipher
            .encrypt(
                XNonce::from_slice(&nonce),
                Payload {
                    msg: plaintext.as_slice(),
                    aad: &aad_bytes,
                },
            )
            .map_err(|_| SyncError::Unwrap)?;
        Ok(Self {
            descriptor: descriptor.clone(),
            wrapped: WrappedRoot { nonce, ciphertext },
        })
    }

    /// 用口令解封根；错口令/错槽/篡改 → [`SyncError::Unwrap`]。
    pub fn unwrap_password(
        &self,
        password: &[u8],
        aad: &impl SlotAad,
    ) -> Result<RootSecretV1, SyncError> {
        let kek = password_wrap_key(&self.descriptor, password)?;
        self.unwrap_with_key(&kek, aad)
    }

    /// 用恢复码解封根；错 R/错槽/篡改 → [`SyncError::Unwrap`]。
    pub fn unwrap_recovery(
        &self,
        seed: &RecoverySeed,
        aad: &impl SlotAad,
    ) -> Result<RootSecretV1, SyncError> {
        let kek = recovery_wrap_key(&self.descriptor, seed)?;
        self.unwrap_with_key(&kek, aad)
    }

    fn unwrap_with_key(
        &self,
        kek: &WrapKey,
        aad: &impl SlotAad,
    ) -> Result<RootSecretV1, SyncError> {
        validate_slot_descriptor(&self.descriptor)?;
        let plaintext_len = self
            .wrapped
            .ciphertext
            .len()
            .checked_sub(TAG_LEN)
            .ok_or(SyncError::Unwrap)?;
        let aad_bytes = aad.aad(&self.descriptor, &self.wrapped.nonce, plaintext_len)?;
        let cipher =
            XChaCha20Poly1305::new_from_slice(kek.expose()).map_err(|_| SyncError::Unwrap)?;
        let plaintext = Zeroizing::new(
            cipher
                .decrypt(
                    XNonce::from_slice(&self.wrapped.nonce),
                    Payload {
                        msg: &self.wrapped.ciphertext,
                        aad: &aad_bytes,
                    },
                )
                .map_err(|_| SyncError::Unwrap)?,
        );
        let root = RootSecretV1::decode(&plaintext)?;
        if root.vault_id != self.descriptor.vault_id || root.key_epoch != self.descriptor.key_epoch
        {
            return Err(SyncError::Descriptor("解出的根归属与槽描述不一致"));
        }
        Ok(root)
    }

    /// ADR §20：KEY_SLOT 的 MNE1 密钥（password 用 Argon2 输出，recovery 用恢复种子）。
    pub fn mne_key(
        &self,
        password: Option<&[u8]>,
        recovery_seed: Option<&RecoverySeed>,
    ) -> Result<crate::keys::Secret32, SyncError> {
        let ikm = match self.descriptor.kind {
            SlotKind::Password => {
                let Kdf::Argon2id(params) = &self.descriptor.kdf else {
                    return Err(SyncError::Descriptor("password 槽的 KDF 不是 Argon2id"));
                };
                let password = password.ok_or(SyncError::Unwrap)?;
                kdf::argon2id_output(password, params)?
            }
            SlotKind::Recovery => {
                let seed = recovery_seed.ok_or(SyncError::Unwrap)?;
                crate::keys::Secret32::from_array(*seed.expose())
            }
        };
        crate::keys::derive_slot_mne_key(
            ikm.expose_slice(),
            &self.descriptor.vault_id,
            self.descriptor.kind,
            self.descriptor.key_epoch,
            &self.descriptor.slot_id,
        )
    }

    /// 槽体序列化（`nonce || ciphertext`）。
    #[must_use]
    pub fn wrapped_bytes(&self) -> Vec<u8> {
        self.wrapped.to_bytes()
    }
}

/// 槽状态（对应 relay `key_slots.state`）。
#[derive(Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Debug)]
pub enum SlotState {
    /// 暂存（尚未激活，24h 回收）。
    Staging,
    /// 当前激活。
    Active,
    /// 待退役（已切换，等待删除）。
    Retiring,
}

/// 槽集合里的一项。
#[derive(Clone)]
pub struct SlotEntry {
    /// 槽本体。
    pub slot: KeySlotV1,
    /// 状态。
    pub state: SlotState,
}

/// 槽集合快照。
#[derive(Clone)]
pub struct SlotSetSnapshot {
    /// 槽集合版本（CAS 用）。
    pub rev: u64,
    /// 全部槽。
    pub slots: Vec<SlotEntry>,
}

/// 改口令所需的 CAS 存储接口。
///
/// **语义要求**：
///
/// - [`Self::stage_slot`] 只落新槽（`state = Staging`），不得改动 active 指针；
/// - [`Self::activate_password_slot`] 必须在 `expected_rev == 当前 rev` 时原子完成
///   "新槽 → Active、旧 active password 槽 → Retiring、rev += 1"，否则返回
///   [`SyncError::Cas`]（ADR §3："带 `expected_slot_set_rev` CAS 原子切 active 指针"）；
/// - [`Self::remove_slot`] 删除指定槽（改口令成功后删旧槽）。
///
/// 该接口由 storage 侧实现（本 crate 不碰 SQLite）；本模块只提供纯逻辑。
pub trait SlotStore {
    /// 读取当前槽集合（含 rev 与状态）。
    fn slot_set(&self) -> Result<SlotSetSnapshot, SyncError>;
    /// 暂存新槽（Staging）。
    fn stage_slot(&mut self, slot: &KeySlotV1) -> Result<(), SyncError>;
    /// CAS 切换 active password 槽；成功返回新的槽集合 rev。
    fn activate_password_slot(
        &mut self,
        expected_rev: u64,
        new_slot_id: &[u8; 32],
    ) -> Result<u64, SyncError>;
    /// 删除槽。
    fn remove_slot(&mut self, slot_id: &[u8; 32]) -> Result<(), SyncError>;
}

/// 改口令的输入。
#[derive(Clone, Copy)]
pub struct PasswordChangePlan<'a> {
    /// 新口令（原样 UTF-8，1..=1024B）。
    pub new_password: &'a [u8],
    /// 新槽 ID（32B 随机，调用方生成并保证不复用）。
    pub new_slot_id: [u8; 32],
    /// 新槽创建时刻。
    pub created_at: u64,
}

/// 改口令的结果。
#[derive(Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Debug)]
pub struct PasswordChangeOutcome {
    /// 切换后的槽集合 rev。
    pub new_slot_set_rev: u64,
    /// 被替换的旧口令槽。
    pub old_slot_id: [u8; 32],
    /// 新口令槽。
    pub new_slot_id: [u8; 32],
}

/// 改口令的**纯逻辑**（ADR §3）：
///
/// 1. 找当前 active 的口令槽（没有则报错）；
/// 2. 用新口令 + 新 salt 生成新 `SlotDescriptorV1`，封装**同一个根**；
/// 3. **试解密校验**：重新派生 KEK 并解封新槽，根必须一致（写入前的自检）；
/// 4. `stage_slot` 暂存新槽；
/// 5. 带 `expected_slot_set_rev` CAS 切换 active（[`SlotStore::activate_password_slot`]）；
/// 6. 删除旧口令槽。
///
/// 不碰数据对象、不换 epoch、不动恢复槽与其他设备 DPAPI——"改口令只重包"。
/// 真正的"从 relay 读回再解密"由调用方在 4→5 之间做；本函数的第 3 步是同一套
/// 派生/解封路径的本地自检。槽指针更新的设备签名也不在这里（属于信封/请求层）。
pub fn change_password<S, A, R>(
    store: &mut S,
    root: &RootSecretV1,
    plan: &PasswordChangePlan<'_>,
    aad: &A,
    rng: &mut R,
) -> Result<PasswordChangeOutcome, SyncError>
where
    S: SlotStore,
    A: SlotAad,
    R: RandomSource,
{
    // 口令长度必须在 Argon2 之前拒绝。
    kdf::validate_password(plan.new_password)?;

    let snapshot = store.slot_set()?;
    let mut active: Option<&SlotEntry> = None;
    for entry in &snapshot.slots {
        if entry.state == SlotState::Active && entry.slot.descriptor.kind == SlotKind::Password {
            if active.is_some() {
                return Err(SyncError::PasswordChange("存在多个 active 口令槽"));
            }
            active = Some(entry);
        }
    }
    let old = active.ok_or(SyncError::PasswordChange("没有 active 口令槽"))?;
    let old_slot_id = old.slot.descriptor.slot_id;
    if old_slot_id == plan.new_slot_id {
        return Err(SyncError::PasswordChange("新槽 ID 与旧槽相同"));
    }

    // 新槽：同 vault/epoch/manager_rev，新 slot_id + 新 salt。
    let params = kdf::new_writer_params(rng)?;
    let descriptor = SlotDescriptorV1 {
        protocol_version: PROTOCOL_VERSION,
        slot_id: plan.new_slot_id,
        vault_id: root.vault_id,
        key_epoch: root.key_epoch,
        kind: SlotKind::Password,
        wrap_suite: WRAP_SUITE_XCHACHA20_POLY1305,
        kdf: Kdf::Argon2id(params),
        created_at: plan.created_at,
        manager_rev: old.slot.descriptor.manager_rev,
    };
    validate_slot_descriptor(&descriptor)?;
    let new_slot = KeySlotV1::wrap_password(&descriptor, plan.new_password, root, aad, rng)?;

    // 试解密校验：重新派生 KEK（再跑一次 Argon2id）并解封，根必须一致。
    let verified = new_slot.unwrap_password(plan.new_password, aad)?;
    if !verified.ct_eq(root) {
        return Err(SyncError::PasswordChange("新槽自检解出的根与当前根不一致"));
    }

    store.stage_slot(&new_slot)?;
    let new_rev = store.activate_password_slot(snapshot.rev, &plan.new_slot_id)?;
    store.remove_slot(&old_slot_id)?;

    Ok(PasswordChangeOutcome {
        new_slot_set_rev: new_rev,
        old_slot_id,
        new_slot_id: plan.new_slot_id,
    })
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    use crate::keys::derive_object_key;
    use crate::keys::Secret32;
    use crate::test_support::TestRng;
    use crate::VaultId;
    use menghunote_sync_proto::{Argon2idParams, EnvelopeHeader, ObjectType};
    use zeroize::Zeroizing;

    fn params(salt: [u8; kdf::SALT_LEN]) -> Argon2idParams {
        kdf::writer_params(salt)
    }

    fn vault() -> VaultId {
        [0x10; 16]
    }

    fn password_descriptor(slot_id: [u8; 32], salt: [u8; kdf::SALT_LEN]) -> SlotDescriptorV1 {
        SlotDescriptorV1 {
            protocol_version: PROTOCOL_VERSION,
            slot_id,
            vault_id: vault(),
            key_epoch: 5,
            kind: SlotKind::Password,
            wrap_suite: WRAP_SUITE_XCHACHA20_POLY1305,
            kdf: Kdf::Argon2id(params(salt)),
            created_at: 1_700_000_000,
            manager_rev: 2,
        }
    }

    fn recovery_descriptor(slot_id: [u8; 32]) -> SlotDescriptorV1 {
        SlotDescriptorV1 {
            protocol_version: PROTOCOL_VERSION,
            slot_id,
            vault_id: vault(),
            key_epoch: 5,
            kind: SlotKind::Recovery,
            wrap_suite: WRAP_SUITE_XCHACHA20_POLY1305,
            kdf: Kdf::RecoveryHkdf,
            created_at: 1_700_000_000,
            manager_rev: 2,
        }
    }

    /// 测试用 AAD：用 proto 的真实 `EnvelopeHeader` 走 ADR §2 的 AAD 构造。
    fn test_aad(
        descriptor: &SlotDescriptorV1,
        nonce: &[u8; NONCE_LEN],
        plaintext_len: usize,
    ) -> Result<Vec<u8>, SyncError> {
        let descriptor_bytes = descriptor.encode()?;
        let header = EnvelopeHeader {
            protocol_version: menghunote_sync_proto::PROTOCOL_VERSION,
            header_len: menghunote_sync_proto::HEADER_LEN as u16,
            object_type: ObjectType::KeySlot,
            cipher_suite: menghunote_sync_proto::CIPHER_SUITE_XCHACHA20_POLY1305,
            flags: 0,
            vault_id: descriptor.vault_id,
            object_id: descriptor.slot_id,
            message_id: [0x0a; 16],
            producer_device_id: [0x0b; 16],
            generation: 0,
            key_epoch: descriptor.key_epoch,
            sender_seq: 0,
            part_index: 0,
            part_count: 1,
            total_plaintext_len: plaintext_len as u64,
            this_plaintext_len: plaintext_len as u32,
            ciphertext_len: (plaintext_len + TAG_LEN) as u32,
            context_hash: context_hash(descriptor)?,
            nonce: *nonce,
        };
        Ok(header.aad(&descriptor_bytes)?)
    }

    #[test]
    fn descriptor_validation_catches_kind_kdf_mismatch() {
        let mut desc = password_descriptor([0x01; 32], [0x02; 16]);
        assert!(validate_slot_descriptor(&desc).is_ok());
        desc.kind = SlotKind::Recovery;
        assert!(matches!(
            validate_slot_descriptor(&desc),
            Err(SyncError::SlotKind { .. })
        ));

        let mut desc = recovery_descriptor([0x03; 32]);
        assert!(validate_slot_descriptor(&desc).is_ok());
        desc.kdf = Kdf::Argon2id(params([0u8; 16]));
        assert!(matches!(
            validate_slot_descriptor(&desc),
            Err(SyncError::SlotKind { .. })
        ));
    }

    #[test]
    fn descriptor_rejects_out_of_range_argon_params_before_kdf() {
        let mut desc = password_descriptor([0u8; 32], [1u8; 16]);
        desc.kdf = Kdf::Argon2id(Argon2idParams {
            version: 0x13,
            m_kib: 1 << 20, // 1 TiB
            t: 3,
            p: 1,
            salt: [0u8; 16],
            output_len: 32,
        });
        // proto 的 encode 会拒绝越界参数
        assert!(desc.encode().is_err());
        // 本地策略校验直接报 Argon2Param（在 KDF 之前）
        assert!(matches!(
            validate_slot_descriptor(&desc),
            Err(SyncError::Argon2Param { field: "m_kib", .. })
        ));
        let started = std::time::Instant::now();
        assert!(password_wrap_key(&desc, b"pw").is_err());
        assert!(started.elapsed().as_millis() < 50, "越界参数不能跑 Argon2");

        // proto 的 decode 侧也会拒绝同一份字节
        let mut good = password_descriptor([0u8; 32], [1u8; 16]);
        good.kdf = Kdf::Argon2id(kdf::writer_params([1u8; 16]));
        let bytes = good.encode().unwrap();
        // 手工把 m_kib 改成 1TiB 不可能（canonical），所以直接断言 proto 参数校验：
        assert!(
            Argon2idParams {
                m_kib: 1 << 20,
                ..kdf::writer_params([1u8; 16])
            }
            .m_kib
                > kdf::M_MAX_KIB
        );
        let _ = bytes;
    }

    #[test]
    fn descriptor_cde_roundtrip_and_context_hash() {
        let desc = password_descriptor([0xab; 32], [0xcd; 16]);
        let bytes = desc.encode().unwrap();
        let parsed = SlotDescriptorV1::decode(&bytes).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(desc, parsed);
        assert_eq!(bytes, parsed.encode().unwrap());
        assert_eq!(bytes[0], 0xa9, "9 项 map 头");
        // context_hash 必须等于 SHA256(descriptor CDE)
        let hash = context_hash(&desc).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(hash.len(), 32);
        assert_ne!(hash, [0u8; 32]);

        // 尾部多余
        let mut long = bytes;
        long.push(0);
        assert!(SlotDescriptorV1::decode(&long).is_err());
    }

    #[test]
    fn password_slot_roundtrip_and_wrong_password() {
        let mut rng = TestRng::new(41);
        let root = RootSecretV1::generate(vault(), 5, &mut rng).unwrap();
        let desc = password_descriptor([0x01; 32], [0x02; 16]);
        let slot =
            KeySlotV1::wrap_password(&desc, b"correct horse", &root, &test_aad, &mut rng).unwrap();

        let opened = slot.unwrap_password(b"correct horse", &test_aad).unwrap();
        assert!(root.ct_eq(&opened));

        // 错口令
        assert!(matches!(
            slot.unwrap_password(b"Correct horse", &test_aad),
            Err(SyncError::Unwrap)
        ));
        // 口令不做 trim：前后空格也失败
        assert!(slot.unwrap_password(b" correct horse ", &test_aad).is_err());
        // AAD 不同（模拟信封字段被改）
        let bad_aad = |_d: &SlotDescriptorV1, _n: &[u8; NONCE_LEN], _l: usize| Ok(vec![0u8; 16]);
        assert!(slot.unwrap_password(b"correct horse", &bad_aad).is_err());
    }

    #[test]
    fn password_slot_rejects_wrong_descriptor_or_body() {
        let mut rng = TestRng::new(42);
        let root = RootSecretV1::generate(vault(), 5, &mut rng).unwrap();
        let desc = password_descriptor([0x01; 32], [0x02; 16]);
        let slot = KeySlotV1::wrap_password(&desc, b"pw", &root, &test_aad, &mut rng).unwrap();

        // 换 slot_id（HKDF info 变了）→ 解封失败
        let mut other_desc = desc.clone();
        other_desc.slot_id = [0x09; 32];
        let mut tampered = slot.clone();
        tampered.descriptor = other_desc;
        assert!(tampered.unwrap_password(b"pw", &test_aad).is_err());

        // 换 epoch（根归属不符）→ 描述/归属校验失败
        let mut epoch_desc = desc.clone();
        epoch_desc.key_epoch = 6;
        let mut tampered = slot.clone();
        tampered.descriptor = epoch_desc;
        assert!(tampered.unwrap_password(b"pw", &test_aad).is_err());

        // 篡改槽体
        let mut tampered = slot.clone();
        tampered.wrapped.ciphertext[0] ^= 1;
        assert!(matches!(
            tampered.unwrap_password(b"pw", &test_aad),
            Err(SyncError::Unwrap)
        ));

        // 截断槽体
        let mut tampered = slot.clone();
        tampered.wrapped.ciphertext.truncate(3);
        assert!(tampered.unwrap_password(b"pw", &test_aad).is_err());
    }

    #[test]
    fn recovery_slot_roundtrip_and_wrong_seed() {
        let mut rng = TestRng::new(43);
        let root = RootSecretV1::generate(vault(), 5, &mut rng).unwrap();
        let seed = RecoverySeed::generate(&mut rng).unwrap();
        let desc = recovery_descriptor([0x03; 32]);
        let slot = KeySlotV1::wrap_recovery(&desc, &seed, &root, &test_aad, &mut rng).unwrap();
        assert!(root.ct_eq(&slot.unwrap_recovery(&seed, &test_aad).unwrap()));

        let other = RecoverySeed::generate(&mut rng).unwrap();
        assert!(matches!(
            slot.unwrap_recovery(&other, &test_aad),
            Err(SyncError::Unwrap)
        ));

        // 用口令路径解恢复槽 → 类型错误
        assert!(matches!(
            slot.unwrap_password(b"pw", &test_aad),
            Err(SyncError::SlotKind { .. })
        ));
    }

    /// 只凭恢复码（不再持有内存中的 R）解出根 —— ADR §11 步 2 的验收点之一。
    #[test]
    fn recovery_code_alone_recovers_root() {
        let mut rng = TestRng::new(49);
        let root = RootSecretV1::generate(vault(), 5, &mut rng).unwrap();
        let seed = RecoverySeed::generate(&mut rng).unwrap();
        let desc = recovery_descriptor([0x23; 32]);
        let slot = KeySlotV1::wrap_recovery(&desc, &seed, &root, &test_aad, &mut rng).unwrap();

        // 用户抄下恢复码，此后 R 不再存在于内存
        let code = seed.to_code().unwrap();
        drop(seed);

        let restored = RecoverySeed::from_code(&code).unwrap();
        let opened = slot.unwrap_recovery(&restored, &test_aad).unwrap();
        assert!(root.ct_eq(&opened));
        // 管理能力也从恢复码独立派生（同一 R 的另一条 HKDF 域）
        let manager =
            crate::device::ManagementKey::from_recovery(&restored, &desc.vault_id).unwrap();
        assert_ne!(manager.public_key(), [0u8; 32]);
    }

    #[test]
    fn wrapped_root_bytes_roundtrip() {
        let mut rng = TestRng::new(44);
        let root = RootSecretV1::generate(vault(), 5, &mut rng).unwrap();
        let desc = password_descriptor([0x04; 32], [0x05; 16]);
        let slot = KeySlotV1::wrap_password(&desc, b"pw", &root, &test_aad, &mut rng).unwrap();
        let bytes = slot.wrapped_bytes();
        assert_eq!(bytes.len(), NONCE_LEN + slot.wrapped.ciphertext.len());
        let parsed = WrappedRoot::from_bytes(&bytes).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(parsed.nonce, slot.wrapped.nonce);
        assert_eq!(parsed.ciphertext, slot.wrapped.ciphertext);
        assert!(WrappedRoot::from_bytes(&bytes[..NONCE_LEN + TAG_LEN - 1]).is_err());
    }

    // ---- 改口令纯逻辑 ----

    struct MemorySlotStore {
        rev: u64,
        entries: Vec<SlotEntry>,
        /// 测试用：模拟"读快照后 rev 被并发推进"，让 CAS 失败。
        race_before_activate: bool,
    }

    impl MemorySlotStore {
        fn new() -> Self {
            Self {
                rev: 1,
                entries: Vec::new(),
                race_before_activate: false,
            }
        }

        fn add(&mut self, slot: KeySlotV1, state: SlotState) {
            self.entries.push(SlotEntry { slot, state });
        }

        fn find(&self, slot_id: &[u8; 32]) -> Option<&SlotEntry> {
            self.entries
                .iter()
                .find(|e| &e.slot.descriptor.slot_id == slot_id)
        }
    }

    impl SlotStore for MemorySlotStore {
        fn slot_set(&self) -> Result<SlotSetSnapshot, SyncError> {
            Ok(SlotSetSnapshot {
                rev: self.rev,
                slots: self.entries.clone(),
            })
        }

        fn stage_slot(&mut self, slot: &KeySlotV1) -> Result<(), SyncError> {
            if self.find(&slot.descriptor.slot_id).is_some() {
                return Err(SyncError::PasswordChange("槽 ID 冲突"));
            }
            self.entries.push(SlotEntry {
                slot: slot.clone(),
                state: SlotState::Staging,
            });
            Ok(())
        }

        fn activate_password_slot(
            &mut self,
            expected_rev: u64,
            new_slot_id: &[u8; 32],
        ) -> Result<u64, SyncError> {
            if self.race_before_activate {
                return Err(SyncError::Cas {
                    expected: expected_rev,
                    actual: expected_rev + 1,
                });
            }
            if expected_rev != self.rev {
                return Err(SyncError::Cas {
                    expected: expected_rev,
                    actual: self.rev,
                });
            }
            for entry in &mut self.entries {
                if entry.state == SlotState::Active
                    && entry.slot.descriptor.kind == SlotKind::Password
                {
                    entry.state = SlotState::Retiring;
                }
            }
            let entry = self
                .entries
                .iter_mut()
                .find(|e| &e.slot.descriptor.slot_id == new_slot_id)
                .ok_or(SyncError::PasswordChange("待激活的槽不存在"))?;
            entry.state = SlotState::Active;
            self.rev += 1;
            Ok(self.rev)
        }

        fn remove_slot(&mut self, slot_id: &[u8; 32]) -> Result<(), SyncError> {
            let before = self.entries.len();
            self.entries
                .retain(|e| &e.slot.descriptor.slot_id != slot_id);
            if self.entries.len() == before {
                return Err(SyncError::PasswordChange("待删除的槽不存在"));
            }
            Ok(())
        }
    }

    fn seeded_store(rng: &mut TestRng, root: &RootSecretV1) -> (MemorySlotStore, RecoverySeed) {
        let mut store = MemorySlotStore::new();
        let desc = password_descriptor([0x11; 32], [0x12; 16]);
        let slot = KeySlotV1::wrap_password(&desc, b"old password", root, &test_aad, rng).unwrap();
        store.add(slot, SlotState::Active);

        let seed = RecoverySeed::generate(rng).unwrap();
        let rec_desc = recovery_descriptor([0x21; 32]);
        let rec_slot = KeySlotV1::wrap_recovery(&rec_desc, &seed, root, &test_aad, rng).unwrap();
        store.add(rec_slot, SlotState::Active);
        (store, seed)
    }

    /// 小工具：用数据对象密钥加解密，验证"改口令后数据密文完全不变"。
    fn data_encrypt(key: &Secret32, nonce: &[u8; NONCE_LEN], plaintext: &[u8]) -> Vec<u8> {
        let cipher = XChaCha20Poly1305::new_from_slice(key.expose_slice()).unwrap();
        cipher
            .encrypt(
                XNonce::from_slice(nonce),
                Payload {
                    msg: plaintext,
                    aad: b"data-object-aad",
                },
            )
            .unwrap()
    }

    fn data_decrypt(
        key: &Secret32,
        nonce: &[u8; NONCE_LEN],
        ciphertext: &[u8],
    ) -> Result<Zeroizing<Vec<u8>>, SyncError> {
        let cipher =
            XChaCha20Poly1305::new_from_slice(key.expose_slice()).map_err(|_| SyncError::Unwrap)?;
        let plaintext = cipher
            .decrypt(
                XNonce::from_slice(nonce),
                Payload {
                    msg: ciphertext,
                    aad: b"data-object-aad",
                },
            )
            .map_err(|_| SyncError::Unwrap)?;
        Ok(Zeroizing::new(plaintext))
    }

    #[test]
    fn change_password_keeps_data_ciphertext_unchanged() {
        let mut rng = TestRng::new(45);
        let root = RootSecretV1::generate(vault(), 5, &mut rng).unwrap();
        let (mut store, seed) = seeded_store(&mut rng, &root);

        // 改口令前：用 K_object 加密一段"笔记正文"
        let object_id = [0x77u8; 32];
        let data_key_before = derive_object_key(&root, ObjectType::Update, &object_id).unwrap();
        let nonce = [0x5au8; NONCE_LEN];
        let ciphertext = data_encrypt(&data_key_before, &nonce, b"note body: hello");
        let ciphertext_before = ciphertext.clone();

        let new_slot_id = [0x31u8; 32];
        let outcome = change_password(
            &mut store,
            &root,
            &PasswordChangePlan {
                new_password: b"new password",
                new_slot_id,
                created_at: 1_700_000_100,
            },
            &test_aad,
            &mut rng,
        )
        .unwrap();
        assert_eq!(outcome.old_slot_id, [0x11u8; 32]);
        assert_eq!(outcome.new_slot_id, new_slot_id);
        assert_eq!(outcome.new_slot_set_rev, 2);

        // 数据密文原样可解 —— 改口令不碰数据
        let data_key_after = derive_object_key(&root, ObjectType::Update, &object_id).unwrap();
        assert!(data_key_before.ct_eq(&data_key_after));
        assert_eq!(ciphertext, ciphertext_before);
        assert_eq!(
            &**data_decrypt(&data_key_after, &nonce, &ciphertext).unwrap(),
            b"note body: hello"
        );

        // 新槽 active 且能解出新口令；旧槽已删除
        let snapshot = store.slot_set().unwrap();
        assert!(snapshot
            .slots
            .iter()
            .all(|e| e.slot.descriptor.slot_id != [0x11u8; 32]));
        let active = snapshot
            .slots
            .iter()
            .find(|e| e.slot.descriptor.slot_id == new_slot_id)
            .expect("新槽必须存在");
        assert_eq!(active.state, SlotState::Active);
        assert!(root.ct_eq(
            &active
                .slot
                .unwrap_password(b"new password", &test_aad)
                .unwrap()
        ));
        // 旧口令失效：新槽不接受旧口令
        assert!(active
            .slot
            .unwrap_password(b"old password", &test_aad)
            .is_err());

        // 恢复槽原封不动（改口令不动恢复码）
        let rec = snapshot
            .slots
            .iter()
            .find(|e| e.slot.descriptor.kind == SlotKind::Recovery)
            .expect("恢复槽必须保留");
        assert_eq!(rec.state, SlotState::Active);
        assert!(root.ct_eq(&rec.slot.unwrap_recovery(&seed, &test_aad).unwrap()));
    }

    #[test]
    fn change_password_cas_conflict_leaves_old_active() {
        let mut rng = TestRng::new(46);
        let root = RootSecretV1::generate(vault(), 5, &mut rng).unwrap();
        let (mut store, _seed) = seeded_store(&mut rng, &root);
        // 模拟并发：读取快照后 rev 被别人推进（CAS 必须失败）
        let stale_rev = store.slot_set().unwrap().rev;
        store.race_before_activate = true;

        let err = change_password(
            &mut store,
            &root,
            &PasswordChangePlan {
                new_password: b"new password",
                new_slot_id: [0x41u8; 32],
                created_at: 1_700_000_100,
            },
            &test_aad,
            &mut rng,
        )
        .unwrap_err();
        assert!(matches!(
            err,
            SyncError::Cas {
                expected,
                actual
            } if expected == stale_rev && actual == stale_rev + 1
        ));
        // 旧口令槽仍是 active，未删除
        let snapshot = store.slot_set().unwrap();
        let old = snapshot
            .slots
            .iter()
            .find(|e| e.slot.descriptor.slot_id == [0x11u8; 32])
            .expect("旧槽必须还在");
        assert_eq!(old.state, SlotState::Active);
        assert!(old.slot.unwrap_password(b"old password", &test_aad).is_ok());
        // 新槽留在 staging（24h 回收，ADR §3）
        let staged = snapshot
            .slots
            .iter()
            .find(|e| e.slot.descriptor.slot_id == [0x41u8; 32])
            .expect("新槽已暂存");
        assert_eq!(staged.state, SlotState::Staging);
    }

    #[test]
    fn change_password_rejects_bad_password_before_kdf() {
        let mut rng = TestRng::new(47);
        let root = RootSecretV1::generate(vault(), 5, &mut rng).unwrap();
        let (mut store, _seed) = seeded_store(&mut rng, &root);

        let started = std::time::Instant::now();
        let err = change_password(
            &mut store,
            &root,
            &PasswordChangePlan {
                new_password: b"",
                new_slot_id: [0x51u8; 32],
                created_at: 1,
            },
            &test_aad,
            &mut rng,
        )
        .unwrap_err();
        assert!(matches!(err, SyncError::PasswordLength { actual: 0, .. }));
        assert!(
            started.elapsed().as_millis() < 50,
            "空口令必须在 Argon2 之前拒绝"
        );
        // 未暂存任何槽
        assert_eq!(store.slot_set().unwrap().slots.len(), 2);
    }

    #[test]
    fn change_password_requires_active_password_slot() {
        let mut rng = TestRng::new(48);
        let root = RootSecretV1::generate(vault(), 5, &mut rng).unwrap();
        let mut store = MemorySlotStore::new();
        let err = change_password(
            &mut store,
            &root,
            &PasswordChangePlan {
                new_password: b"pw",
                new_slot_id: [0x61u8; 32],
                created_at: 1,
            },
            &test_aad,
            &mut rng,
        )
        .unwrap_err();
        assert!(matches!(err, SyncError::PasswordChange(_)));
    }
}
`````

`````rust
//! storage 只读 API 的薄适配层（S7-8）。
//!
//! 真源是 `crates/storage/src/read_api.rs`（`body_doc_meta` / `loro_update_payload` /
//! `loro_update_base_vv` / `doc_updates_since` / `doc_snapshot` / `read_doc_bootstrap` /
//! `read_doc_for_export` / `doc_exists`）。本模块**不写任何 SQL、不直接访问表**，只做：
//!
//! 1. 错误分类：`StorageError::HeadConflict`（head CAS 失败）→ [`SyncError::HeadConflict`]，
//!    它是**可重试**的并发冲突，不是数据丢失；
//! 2. 统一 `storage_view::*` 调用点，方便后续 bootstrap/checkpoint 复用同一套读路径。
//!
//! 出站加密用 `doc_meta` + `stored_update` + `base_vv_at`；入站依赖检查用
//! `doc_exists`；bootstrap/导出用 `updates_since` / `bootstrap` / `export_at_head`。

use crate::error::SyncError;
use menghunote_storage::{
    body_doc_meta, doc_exists as storage_doc_exists, doc_updates_since, loro_update_base_vv,
    loro_update_payload, read_doc_bootstrap, read_doc_for_export, BodyDocMeta, DocBootstrap,
    DocExport, StorageError, StoredLoroUpdate, Vault,
};

pub use menghunote_storage::DocSnapshot;

/// 把 storage 错误映射成 sync 错误；head CAS 冲突保持"可重试"语义。
#[must_use]
pub fn map_storage_error(error: StorageError) -> SyncError {
    match error {
        StorageError::HeadConflict {
            doc_id,
            expected,
            actual,
        } => SyncError::HeadConflict {
            doc_id,
            expected,
            actual,
        },
        other => SyncError::Storage(other),
    }
}

/// 读正文文档元数据；不存在返回 `None`。
pub fn doc_meta(vault: &Vault, doc_id: &str) -> Result<Option<BodyDocMeta>, SyncError> {
    body_doc_meta(vault, doc_id).map_err(map_storage_error)
}

/// 文档是否存在（入站 update 的依赖是否就绪）。
pub fn doc_exists(vault: &Vault, doc_id: &str) -> Result<bool, SyncError> {
    storage_doc_exists(vault, doc_id).map_err(map_storage_error)
}

/// 读出站 `(doc_id, seq)` 的 update 明文列。
pub fn stored_update(vault: &Vault, doc_id: &str, seq: u64) -> Result<StoredLoroUpdate, SyncError> {
    loro_update_payload(vault, doc_id, seq).map_err(map_storage_error)
}

/// `seq` 之前的 VV（出站 `base_vv`；`seq <= 1` 为空）。
pub fn base_vv_at(vault: &Vault, doc_id: &str, seq: u64) -> Result<Vec<u8>, SyncError> {
    loro_update_base_vv(vault, doc_id, seq).map_err(map_storage_error)
}

/// `seq > after_seq` 的 update（升序），出站范围/校验用。
pub fn updates_since(
    vault: &Vault,
    doc_id: &str,
    after_seq: u64,
) -> Result<Vec<StoredLoroUpdate>, SyncError> {
    doc_updates_since(vault, doc_id, after_seq).map_err(map_storage_error)
}

/// 从快照 + 后续 update 组装 bootstrap 读取包（无快照时 `snapshot` 为 `None`）。
pub fn bootstrap(vault: &Vault, doc_id: &str) -> Result<Option<DocBootstrap>, SyncError> {
    read_doc_bootstrap(vault, doc_id).map_err(map_storage_error)
}

/// 按期望 head 做一致性导出；head 不匹配返回可重试的 [`SyncError::HeadConflict`]，
/// **绝不返回半截快照**。
pub fn export_at_head(
    vault: &Vault,
    doc_id: &str,
    expected_head_seq: u64,
) -> Result<DocExport, SyncError> {
    read_doc_for_export(vault, doc_id, expected_head_seq).map_err(map_storage_error)
}
`````

`````rust
//! 仅测试用的共享辅助：确定性随机源、内存槽存储、本地身份封装初始化。

use crate::error::SyncError;
use crate::random::RandomSource;
use std::sync::OnceLock;

/// 让本测试进程具备可用的本地身份封装（仅 Linux 需要主密钥文件）。
///
/// - 在测试进程首次调用时设置**独立、vault 之外**的 `XDG_DATA_HOME`
///   （`CARGO_TARGET_TMPDIR/xdg-<pid>`），然后调用生产入口
///   [`crate::identity_wrap::initialize_user_key`]；
/// - 之后既有的 `identity.protect/unprotect` 调用完全不变，**没有**测试旁路；
/// - `OnceLock` 保证多测试线程并发调用只初始化一次；Windows 上 `initialize_user_key`
///   是 no-op（DPAPI 不需要文件）。
pub fn ensure_local_wrap() {
    static READY: OnceLock<()> = OnceLock::new();
    READY.get_or_init(|| {
        #[cfg(target_os = "linux")]
        {
            // lib 单测目标不一定有编译期 CARGO_TARGET_TMPDIR：运行时回退到仓库 target/tmp。
            let root = std::env::var_os("CARGO_TARGET_TMPDIR")
                .map(std::path::PathBuf::from)
                .unwrap_or_else(|| {
                    std::path::Path::new(env!("CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR")).join("../../target/tmp")
                });
            let dir = root.join(format!("xdg-{}", std::process::id()));
            std::fs::create_dir_all(&dir).expect("创建测试 XDG_DATA_HOME");
            std::env::set_var("XDG_DATA_HOME", &dir);
        }
        crate::identity_wrap::initialize_user_key().expect("初始化测试用户主密钥");
    });
}

/// 确定性随机源（SplitMix64）。
///
/// **只用于测试**：让"随机"可复现，断言能稳定命中。不要在生产路径使用。
pub struct TestRng {
    state: u64,
}

impl TestRng {
    /// 用种子构造（不同种子产生不同流）。
    #[must_use]
    pub fn new(seed: u64) -> Self {
        Self {
            state: seed.wrapping_mul(0x9E37_79B9_7F4A_7C15).wrapping_add(1),
        }
    }
}

impl RandomSource for TestRng {
    fn fill(&mut self, dst: &mut [u8]) -> Result<(), SyncError> {
        for chunk in dst.chunks_mut(8) {
            self.state = self.state.wrapping_add(0x9E37_79B9_7F4A_7C15);
            let mut z = self.state;
            z = (z ^ (z >> 30)).wrapping_mul(0xBF58_476D_1CE4_E5B9);
            z = (z ^ (z >> 27)).wrapping_mul(0x94D0_49BB_1331_11EB);
            z ^= z >> 31;
            let bytes = z.to_le_bytes();
            chunk.copy_from_slice(&bytes[..chunk.len()]);
        }
        Ok(())
    }
}
`````

`````rust
//! 通用对象上传器（S7-14）：KEY_SLOT / SNAPSHOT / MANIFEST / ASSET。
//!
//! 引擎的 UPDATE 走 storage outbox（可重试/持久化）；checkpoint 与初始槽是一次性导出，
//! 因此这里直接构造 MNE1 对象并上传，复用同一套固定切片/AAD/K_object/ObjectCommit 规则。
//!
//! 每个对象流程：
//! 1. `part_count_for` / `expected_part_plain_len` 切固定片；
//! 2. 每片随机 nonce（KEY_SLOT 复用槽体 nonce，见 [`upload_object`]），
//!    `header.aad(descriptor)` 作 AAD，XChaCha20-Poly1305 加密；
//! 3. `PUT part` → `ObjectCommit` + 设备签名 → `submit_object`（relay 侧 complete）；
//! 4. `object_digest` 按 §2 重算并随 commit 提交。

use chacha20poly1305::aead::{Aead, KeyInit, Payload};
use chacha20poly1305::{XChaCha20Poly1305, XNonce};
use sha2::{Digest, Sha256};

use crate::device::DeviceSigningKey;
use crate::error::SyncError;
use crate::keys::{derive_object_key, RootSecretV1};
use crate::relay::{ObjectSubmission, RelayClient, UpdateStatus};
use crate::{DeviceId, ObjectId, VaultId};
use menghunote_sync_proto::{
    cap_plain, expected_part_plain_len, object_commit_signing_input, object_digest_input,
    part_count_for, Envelope, EnvelopeHeader, ObjectCommit, ObjectType, MAX_ASSET_RAW_BYTES,
    MAX_KEY_SLOT_PLAINTEXT, MAX_LORO_SNAPSHOT_BYTES, MAX_MANIFEST_CDE_BYTES, MAX_UPDATE_CDE_BYTES,
};

/// 已上传对象的最小事实集（构造 manifest/refs/读回校验用）。
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct UploadedObject {
    /// 对象 id。
    pub object_id: ObjectId,
    /// 分片数。
    pub part_count: u32,
    /// 明文总长。
    pub total_plain_len: u64,
    /// 密文对象摘要（§2）。
    pub object_digest: [u8; 32],
}

/// 上传一个对象并 complete。
///
/// - `descriptor`：KEY_SLOT 的 `CDE(SlotDescriptorV1)`；其他类型传空切片；
/// - `nonce_override`：KEY_SLOT 必须复用槽体 nonce（包封时 AAD 已绑定它）；
///   其他类型传 `None`（每片随机）。
#[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
pub fn upload_object<C: RelayClient>(
    client: &mut C,
    vault_id: VaultId,
    producer_device_id: DeviceId,
    signing_key: &DeviceSigningKey,
    root: &RootSecretV1,
    object_type: ObjectType,
    object_id: ObjectId,
    message_id: [u8; 16],
    generation: u64,
    sender_seq: u64,
    plaintext: &[u8],
    descriptor: &[u8],
    nonce_override: Option<[u8; 24]>,
) -> Result<UploadedObject, SyncError> {
    upload_object_inner(
        client,
        vault_id,
        producer_device_id,
        signing_key,
        root,
        object_type,
        object_id,
        message_id,
        generation,
        sender_seq,
        plaintext,
        descriptor,
        nonce_override,
        None,
        None,
    )
}

#[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
fn upload_object_inner<C: RelayClient>(
    client: &mut C,
    vault_id: VaultId,
    producer_device_id: DeviceId,
    signing_key: &DeviceSigningKey,
    root: &RootSecretV1,
    object_type: ObjectType,
    object_id: ObjectId,
    message_id: [u8; 16],
    generation: u64,
    sender_seq: u64,
    plaintext: &[u8],
    descriptor: &[u8],
    nonce_override: Option<[u8; 24]>,
    key_override: Option<&crate::keys::Secret32>,
    reservation: Option<&[u8; 16]>,
) -> Result<UploadedObject, SyncError> {
    // 流式：加密一片就 PUT 一片，不把整个对象（SNAPSHOT 上限 4GiB）全留在内存里。
    let summary = encrypt_object_parts(
        root,
        vault_id,
        producer_device_id,
        object_type,
        object_id,
        message_id,
        generation,
        sender_seq,
        plaintext,
        descriptor,
        nonce_override,
        key_override,
        |part_no, envelope, _digest| {
            client.put_part_with_reservation(&object_id, part_no, envelope, reservation)
        },
    )?;
    submit_prepared_object(
        client,
        vault_id,
        signing_key,
        object_type,
        object_id,
        message_id,
        generation,
        root.key_epoch,
        sender_seq,
        summary.part_count,
        summary.total_plain_len,
        &summary.object_digest,
    )?;
    Ok(UploadedObject {
        object_id,
        part_count: summary.part_count,
        total_plain_len: summary.total_plain_len,
        object_digest: summary.object_digest,
    })
}

/// 加密完成的对象事实（不含分片字节；ASSET 需要分片时由 [`encrypt_asset_parts`] 收集）。
pub(crate) struct EncryptedObjectSummary {
    /// 分片数。
    pub(crate) part_count: u32,
    /// 明文总长。
    pub(crate) total_plain_len: u64,
    /// 密文对象摘要（§2）。
    pub(crate) object_digest: [u8; 32],
}

/// 已加密对象：固定切片后的全部分片 + 提交所需事实。
///
/// 抽出来是为了让"先检查 relay 上是否已有同一对象"的调用方（增量资产上传 /
/// checkpoint 复用）能**本地重算确定性密文**并逐片比对，而不是重写一套加密逻辑。
pub(crate) struct EncryptedObjectParts {
    /// 分片数。
    pub(crate) part_count: u32,
    /// 明文总长。
    pub(crate) total_plain_len: u64,
    /// `(part_no, envelope, part_digest)`。
    pub(crate) parts: EncryptedLocalParts,
    /// 密文对象摘要（§2）。
    pub(crate) object_digest: [u8; 32],
}

impl EncryptedObjectSummary {
    /// 转换为"带全部分片"的资产结果（ASSET ≤64MiB，可整体留在内存里做逐片比对）。
    pub(crate) fn with_parts(self, parts: EncryptedLocalParts) -> EncryptedObjectParts {
        EncryptedObjectParts {
            part_count: self.part_count,
            total_plain_len: self.total_plain_len,
            parts,
            object_digest: self.object_digest,
        }
    }
}

/// 用当前根把一段 ASSET 明文头加密成**确定性** MNE1 分片（ADR §19/§31）。
///
/// 与 [`upload_object`] 的 ASSET 分支共用同一条加密实现：确定性 nonce、producer=0、
/// 确定性 message_id、generation/sender_seq=0。因此同一 `(root, object_id, 明文)`
/// 在任何设备/任何进程重算出的分片字节都相同，relay 可以幂等接受、普通同步与
/// checkpoint 上传也可以逐片比对/复用。
pub(crate) fn encrypt_asset_parts(
    root: &RootSecretV1,
    vault_id: VaultId,
    object_id: ObjectId,
    plaintext: &[u8],
) -> Result<EncryptedObjectParts, SyncError> {
    let message_id = asset_message_id(root, &object_id)?;
    let mut parts = Vec::new();
    let summary = encrypt_object_parts(
        root,
        vault_id,
        [0u8; 16],
        ObjectType::Asset,
        object_id,
        message_id,
        0,
        0,
        plaintext,
        &[],
        None,
        None,
        |part_no, envelope, digest| {
            parts.push((part_no, envelope.to_vec(), digest));
            Ok(())
        },
    )?;
    Ok(summary.with_parts(parts))
}

/// 提交已上传完分片的对象（`ObjectCommit` + 设备签名 + `submit_object`）。
///
/// 与 [`upload_object`] 尾部完全同口径；分片已由调用方按需上传（含"跳过 relay 上
/// 已存在的幂等分片"）后调用。
#[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
pub(crate) fn submit_prepared_object<C: RelayClient>(
    client: &mut C,
    vault_id: VaultId,
    signing_key: &DeviceSigningKey,
    object_type: ObjectType,
    object_id: ObjectId,
    message_id: [u8; 16],
    generation: u64,
    key_epoch: u64,
    sender_seq: u64,
    part_count: u32,
    total_plain_len: u64,
    object_digest: &[u8; 32],
) -> Result<(), SyncError> {
    let commit = ObjectCommit {
        vault_id,
        object_id,
        message_id,
        object_type,
        generation,
        key_epoch,
        sender_seq,
        part_count,
        total_len: total_plain_len,
        object_digest: *object_digest,
    };
    let signed_commit = commit.encode()?;
    let signature = signing_key.sign(&object_commit_signing_input(&commit)?);
    let outcome = client.submit_object(ObjectSubmission {
        object_id,
        commit,
        signed_commit,
        signature,
    })?;
    match outcome.status {
        UpdateStatus::Accepted { .. } | UpdateStatus::Duplicate => Ok(()),
        UpdateStatus::Failed { code, retryable } => Err(SyncError::RelayApi {
            code: code.unwrap_or_else(|| "OBJECT_FAILED".to_owned()),
            retryable,
            current_epoch: None,
            current_control_rev: None,
            bootstrap_hint: None,
        }),
    }
}

/// 固定切片 + MNE1 加密（`upload_object` 与增量资产上传共用）。
#[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
fn encrypt_object_parts(
    root: &RootSecretV1,
    vault_id: VaultId,
    producer_device_id: DeviceId,
    object_type: ObjectType,
    object_id: ObjectId,
    message_id: [u8; 16],
    generation: u64,
    sender_seq: u64,
    plaintext: &[u8],
    descriptor: &[u8],
    nonce_override: Option<[u8; 24]>,
    key_override: Option<&crate::keys::Secret32>,
    mut emit: impl FnMut(u32, &[u8], [u8; 32]) -> Result<(), SyncError>,
) -> Result<EncryptedObjectSummary, SyncError> {
    if plaintext.is_empty() {
        return Err(SyncError::LocalCorrupt("对象明文为空"));
    }
    let total = plaintext.len() as u64;
    let part_count = u32::try_from(part_count_for(total, object_type))
        .map_err(|_| SyncError::LocalCorrupt("分片数超出 u32"))?;
    let key = match key_override {
        Some(key) => key.clone(),
        None => derive_object_key(root, object_type, &object_id)?,
    };
    let cipher = XChaCha20Poly1305::new_from_slice(key.expose_slice())
        .map_err(|_| SyncError::Object("数据密钥长度非法"))?;
    let cap = cap_plain(object_type) as usize;
    let mut rng = crate::random::OsRandom;
    let mut digests = Vec::with_capacity(part_count as usize);
    for index in 0..part_count {
        let this_len = expected_part_plain_len(object_type, total, index)?;
        let start = index as usize * cap;
        let end = start
            .checked_add(this_len)
            .ok_or(SyncError::LocalCorrupt("分片偏移溢出"))?;
        let chunk = plaintext
            .get(start..end)
            .ok_or(SyncError::LocalCorrupt("分片超出明文长度"))?;
        let nonce = if let Some(nonce) = nonce_override {
            if index == 0 {
                nonce
            } else {
                crate::random::array::<24>(&mut rng)?
            }
        } else if object_type == ObjectType::Asset {
            // ADR §19：ASSET 用确定性 nonce，保证跨进程重传密文字节一致、relay 幂等。
            asset_nonce(&key, &vault_id, &object_id, index)?
        } else {
            crate::random::array::<24>(&mut rng)?
        };
        let header = EnvelopeHeader {
            protocol_version: 1,
            header_len: 196,
            object_type,
            cipher_suite: 1,
            flags: 0,
            vault_id,
            object_id,
            message_id,
            // ADR §31：ASSET 的 AAD 不得包含 producer_device_id（否则两台设备上传
            // 同一资产会得到不同 AAD/密文字节）。header 字段固定为 0；其他类型保持真实值。
            producer_device_id: asset_producer(object_type, producer_device_id),
            generation,
            key_epoch: root.key_epoch,
            sender_seq,
            part_index: index,
            part_count,
            total_plaintext_len: total,
            this_plaintext_len: u32::try_from(chunk.len())
                .map_err(|_| SyncError::LocalCorrupt("分片明文超出 u32"))?,
            ciphertext_len: u32::try_from(chunk.len() + 16)
                .map_err(|_| SyncError::LocalCorrupt("分片密文超出 u32"))?,
            context_hash: context_hash_for(object_type, descriptor)?,
            nonce,
        };
        let aad = header.aad(descriptor)?;
        let ciphertext = cipher
            .encrypt(
                XNonce::from_slice(&nonce),
                Payload {
                    msg: chunk,
                    aad: &aad,
                },
            )
            .map_err(|_| SyncError::Object("对象加密失败"))?;
        let envelope = Envelope::new(header, ciphertext)?.encode()?;
        let digest: [u8; 32] = Sha256::digest(&envelope).into();
        digests.push(digest);
        emit(index, &envelope, digest)?;
    }
    let digest_input = object_digest_input(part_count, &digests)?;
    let object_digest: [u8; 32] = Sha256::digest(&digest_input).into();
    Ok(EncryptedObjectSummary {
        part_count,
        total_plain_len: total,
        object_digest,
    })
}

/// 读回一个对象：拉全部片、校验摘要/类型/长度、解密并返回 `(header, plaintext)`。
///
/// 用于 checkpoint/slot 的"从 relay 读回解密/导入"验证；KEY_SLOT 需要传 descriptor。
#[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
pub fn fetch_object<C: RelayClient>(
    client: &mut C,
    root: &RootSecretV1,
    object_type: ObjectType,
    object_id: &ObjectId,
    part_count: u32,
    total_plain_len: u64,
    expected_digest: &[u8; 32],
    descriptor: &[u8],
) -> Result<(EnvelopeHeader, Vec<u8>), SyncError> {
    fetch_object_inner(
        client,
        root,
        object_type,
        object_id,
        part_count,
        total_plain_len,
        expected_digest,
        descriptor,
        None,
        None,
    )
}

/// ASSET 真实验证的**完整期望声明**（全部字段来自本机事实/已绑定声明，不是读回后自证）。
///
/// 这是 checkpoint writer 与 engine pull 共用的唯一 ASSET 来源认证入口：任何一条
/// 字段不符都不得产出"已验证资产"事实。
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy)]
pub(crate) struct AssetExpectation<'a> {
    /// 声明对象 id（必须是完整明文头的 canonical HMAC）。
    pub object_id: &'a ObjectId,
    /// 声明对象类型（只接受 ASSET）。
    pub object_type: ObjectType,
    /// 声明 generation。
    pub generation: u64,
    /// 声明 message_id；`None` 表示"只要求等于本根确定性派生值"（refs 路径）。
    pub message_id: Option<[u8; 16]>,
    /// 声明 sender_seq。
    pub sender_seq: u64,
    /// 声明分片数。
    pub part_count: u32,
    /// 声明明文总长。
    pub total_len: u64,
    /// 声明密文对象摘要。
    pub object_digest: &'a [u8; 32],
    /// 声明 key epoch（必须等于验证根的 epoch）。
    pub key_epoch: u64,
}

/// 一次 ASSET 真实验证通过后的**事实集**：不含明文、不含密文。
///
/// 由 [`fetch_verified_asset`] / [`fetch_verified_asset_data`] 产出；调用方可以把它们
/// 写进本地记录/缓存。需要把资产真正落进本地 `assets` 表的调用方（engine pull）走
/// [`fetch_verified_asset_data`] 拿到**已完成校验**的数据字节，不得从事实集反推明文。
#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub(crate) struct VerifiedAssetFacts {
    /// 资产数据真实 SHA256（来自解密后的 canonical 明文头）。
    pub real_sha256: [u8; 32],
    /// 资产数据真实字节数。
    pub byte_len: u64,
    /// 资产 MIME（canonical 头的一部分）。
    pub media_type: String,
    /// 由实际密文分片重算并与声明核对的 object_digest。
    pub object_digest: [u8; 32],
}

/// 每片 MNE1 header 的期望上下文（ASSET 来源认证用）。
///
/// `fetch_object` 只校验 object_type/object_id/part_index/part_count；本结构把
/// **每一片**的 vault/epoch/generation/sender/message/producer 也固定下来，防止
/// relay 用同一对象的不同声明混片。
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy)]
struct ExpectedEnvelopeContext {
    vault_id: VaultId,
    key_epoch: u64,
    generation: u64,
    sender_seq: u64,
    message_id: [u8; 16],
    producer_device_id: DeviceId,
}

/// 真实下载并验证一个 ASSET：分片上限/分配保护、固定切片、每片 header 上下文、
/// AEAD（AAD）、密文 digest、明文长度、data SHA256、MIME、根派生 OID 重算。
///
/// `max_total_len` 是调用方允许的最大声明总长（与协议 `MAX_ASSET_RAW_BYTES` 取小）；
/// 声明超限在**任何分配之前**拒绝。返回事实集，不返回持久明文。
///
/// checkpoint writer 的 refs/coverage 复核与 engine pull 的 skipped-asset 落盘都必须
/// 走这里，保证"同一份声明"只有一种验证口径。
pub(crate) fn fetch_verified_asset<C: RelayClient>(
    client: &mut C,
    root: &RootSecretV1,
    vault_id: VaultId,
    max_total_len: u64,
    expected: &AssetExpectation<'_>,
) -> Result<VerifiedAssetFacts, SyncError> {
    fetch_verified_asset_inner(client, root, vault_id, max_total_len, expected)
        .map(|(facts, _data)| facts)
}

/// 同 [`fetch_verified_asset`]，但**额外交还**本机验证过的资产数据字节。
///
/// 只有"要真正把资产落到本地 `assets` 表"的调用方（engine pull 的 ASSET 消费）用这个
/// 入口；checkpoint writer 的 coverage 复核仍然只用事实集，不碰明文。
///
/// 返回的 `Vec<u8>` 已经过完整校验：长度 = 明文头声明、SHA-256 = `real_sha256`、根派生
/// `object_id` 与声明一致。调用方可以把它直接写进内容寻址的资产表。
pub(crate) fn fetch_verified_asset_data<C: RelayClient>(
    client: &mut C,
    root: &RootSecretV1,
    vault_id: VaultId,
    max_total_len: u64,
    expected: &AssetExpectation<'_>,
) -> Result<(VerifiedAssetFacts, Vec<u8>), SyncError> {
    fetch_verified_asset_inner(client, root, vault_id, max_total_len, expected)
}

fn fetch_verified_asset_inner<C: RelayClient>(
    client: &mut C,
    root: &RootSecretV1,
    vault_id: VaultId,
    max_total_len: u64,
    expected: &AssetExpectation<'_>,
) -> Result<(VerifiedAssetFacts, Vec<u8>), SyncError> {
    if expected.object_type != ObjectType::Asset {
        return Err(SyncError::Object("共享 ASSET 验证器只接受 ASSET 声明"));
    }
    if root.vault_id != vault_id || root.key_epoch != expected.key_epoch {
        return Err(SyncError::Object("ASSET 验证根与声明的 vault/epoch 不一致"));
    }
    let cap = max_total_len.min(MAX_ASSET_RAW_BYTES as u64);
    if expected.total_len == 0 || expected.total_len > cap {
        return Err(SyncError::Object("ASSET 声明总长越界"));
    }
    if expected.part_count == 0 {
        return Err(SyncError::Object("ASSET 声明分片数为 0"));
    }
    // ASSET message_id 必须由根/object_id 确定性派生（ADR §19：重传密文字节一致）。
    let derived_message_id = asset_message_id(root, expected.object_id)?;
    if let Some(declared) = expected.message_id {
        if declared != derived_message_id {
            return Err(SyncError::Object(
                "ASSET 声明的 message_id 不是本根确定性派生值",
            ));
        }
    }
    let context = ExpectedEnvelopeContext {
        vault_id,
        key_epoch: expected.key_epoch,
        generation: expected.generation,
        sender_seq: expected.sender_seq,
        message_id: derived_message_id,
        producer_device_id: [0u8; 16],
    };
    let (header, plaintext) = fetch_object_inner(
        client,
        root,
        ObjectType::Asset,
        expected.object_id,
        expected.part_count,
        expected.total_len,
        expected.object_digest,
        &[],
        None,
        Some(&context),
    )
    .map_err(|err| match err {
        // 信封结构错误语义上是"对象无效"，与 UPDATE 路径保持一致（不把
        // Proto 细节当成 relay 协议错误）。
        SyncError::Proto(_) => SyncError::Object("ASSET 密文不符合 MNE1 契约"),
        other => other,
    })?;
    // 首片 header 的最终校验（逐片上下文已在上面的循环里校验）。
    if header.object_type != ObjectType::Asset
        || header.vault_id != vault_id
        || header.object_id != *expected.object_id
        || header.part_index != 0
        || header.part_count != expected.part_count
        || header.total_plaintext_len != expected.total_len
        || header.key_epoch != expected.key_epoch
        || header.generation != expected.generation
        || header.sender_seq != expected.sender_seq
        || header.message_id != derived_message_id
        || header.producer_device_id != [0u8; 16]
    {
        return Err(SyncError::Object("ASSET 信封 header 与完整声明不一致"));
    }
    // 明文头 = 32B real_sha256 + BE64 byte_len + BE16 mime_len + MIME + data；
    // 这里会校验 data.len()==byte_len 且 SHA256(data)==real_sha256。
    let (real_sha256, byte_len, media_type) =
        crate::rotation_stage::decode_asset_plaintext(&plaintext)?;
    // 根派生 object_id 重算：MIME 非空/≤255 在这里 fail-closed。不一致说明声明的
    // 对象不是这份明文（典型：伪造 ASSET / 被替换资产）。
    let canonical = crate::checkpoint::asset_object_id(root, &real_sha256, byte_len, &media_type)?;
    if canonical != *expected.object_id {
        return Err(SyncError::Object(
            "ASSET 明文头重算的 object_id 与声明不一致",
        ));
    }
    // data 段：明文头长度 32+8+2 + MIME 字节。`decode_asset_plaintext` 已校验尾部长度与
    // SHA-256，这里只做切片（越界/长度不符都已在上一步 fail-closed）。
    let data_start = 42 + media_type.len();
    let data = plaintext
        .get(data_start..)
        .ok_or(SyncError::Object("ASSET 明文数据越界"))?
        .to_vec();
    Ok((
        VerifiedAssetFacts {
            real_sha256,
            byte_len,
            media_type,
            object_digest: *expected.object_digest,
        },
        data,
    ))
}

/// ADR §20：用调用方给定的 `K_slot_mne` 读回 KEY_SLOT。
#[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
pub fn fetch_object_with_key<C: RelayClient>(
    client: &mut C,
    root: &RootSecretV1,
    object_type: ObjectType,
    object_id: &ObjectId,
    part_count: u32,
    total_plain_len: u64,
    expected_digest: &[u8; 32],
    descriptor: &[u8],
    key: &crate::keys::Secret32,
) -> Result<(EnvelopeHeader, Vec<u8>), SyncError> {
    fetch_object_inner(
        client,
        root,
        object_type,
        object_id,
        part_count,
        total_plain_len,
        expected_digest,
        descriptor,
        Some(key),
        None,
    )
}

/// 本地重打包产物：`(part_no, envelope, part_digest)`。
pub type EncryptedLocalParts = Vec<(u32, Vec<u8>, [u8; 32])>;

/// 用新 epoch 根把同一明文重新加密成 MNE1 parts（阶段 J 重打包用）。
///
/// 返回 `(part_no, envelope, part_digest)` 与对象 digest；不接触 relay。
#[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
pub fn encrypt_local_parts(
    root: &RootSecretV1,
    object_type: ObjectType,
    object_id: &ObjectId,
    message_id: [u8; 16],
    producer_device_id: DeviceId,
    generation: u64,
    sender_seq: u64,
    plaintext: &[u8],
    descriptor: &[u8],
) -> Result<(EncryptedLocalParts, [u8; 32]), SyncError> {
    if plaintext.is_empty() {
        return Err(SyncError::LocalCorrupt("重打包明文为空"));
    }
    let total = plaintext.len() as u64;
    let part_count = u32::try_from(part_count_for(total, object_type))
        .map_err(|_| SyncError::LocalCorrupt("分片数超出 u32"))?;
    let key = derive_object_key(root, object_type, object_id)?;
    let cipher = XChaCha20Poly1305::new_from_slice(key.expose_slice())
        .map_err(|_| SyncError::Object("数据密钥长度非法"))?;
    let cap = cap_plain(object_type) as usize;
    let mut rng = crate::random::OsRandom;
    let mut parts = Vec::with_capacity(part_count as usize);
    let mut digests = Vec::with_capacity(part_count as usize);
    for index in 0..part_count {
        let this_len = expected_part_plain_len(object_type, total, index)?;
        let start = index as usize * cap;
        let end = start
            .checked_add(this_len)
            .ok_or(SyncError::LocalCorrupt("分片偏移溢出"))?;
        let chunk = plaintext
            .get(start..end)
            .ok_or(SyncError::LocalCorrupt("分片超出明文长度"))?;
        let nonce = crate::random::array::<24>(&mut rng)?;
        let header = EnvelopeHeader {
            protocol_version: 1,
            header_len: 196,
            object_type,
            cipher_suite: 1,
            flags: 0,
            vault_id: root.vault_id,
            object_id: *object_id,
            message_id,
            producer_device_id,
            generation,
            key_epoch: root.key_epoch,
            sender_seq,
            part_index: index,
            part_count,
            total_plaintext_len: total,
            this_plaintext_len: u32::try_from(chunk.len())
                .map_err(|_| SyncError::LocalCorrupt("分片明文超出 u32"))?,
            ciphertext_len: u32::try_from(chunk.len() + 16)
                .map_err(|_| SyncError::LocalCorrupt("分片密文超出 u32"))?,
            context_hash: context_hash_for(object_type, descriptor)?,
            nonce,
        };
        let aad = header.aad(descriptor)?;
        let ciphertext = cipher
            .encrypt(
                XNonce::from_slice(&nonce),
                Payload {
                    msg: chunk,
                    aad: &aad,
                },
            )
            .map_err(|_| SyncError::Object("重打包加密失败"))?;
        let envelope = Envelope::new(header, ciphertext)?.encode()?;
        digests.push(Sha256::digest(&envelope).into());
        parts.push((index, envelope, digests[index as usize]));
    }
    let digest_input = object_digest_input(part_count, &digests)?;
    let object_digest: [u8; 32] = Sha256::digest(&digest_input).into();
    Ok((parts, object_digest))
}

/// 解密**本地持久化**的单个 MNE1 part（阶段 J 重打包用）。
///
/// 明文仅放在 `Zeroizing` 缓冲中返回；调用方必须立即重新加密，不得落库。
pub fn decrypt_envelope(
    root: &RootSecretV1,
    expected_type: ObjectType,
    expected_object_id: &ObjectId,
    envelope_bytes: &[u8],
    descriptor: &[u8],
) -> Result<(EnvelopeHeader, zeroize::Zeroizing<Vec<u8>>), SyncError> {
    let envelope = Envelope::decode(envelope_bytes)?;
    if envelope.header.object_type != expected_type
        || envelope.header.object_id != *expected_object_id
    {
        return Err(SyncError::Object("本地 part 的 header 与 outbox 记录不符"));
    }
    let key = derive_object_key(root, expected_type, expected_object_id)?;
    let cipher = XChaCha20Poly1305::new_from_slice(key.expose_slice())
        .map_err(|_| SyncError::Object("数据密钥长度非法"))?;
    let aad = envelope.header.aad(descriptor)?;
    let plaintext = cipher
        .decrypt(
            XNonce::from_slice(&envelope.header.nonce),
            Payload {
                msg: &envelope.ciphertext,
                aad: &aad,
            },
        )
        .map_err(|_| SyncError::Object("本地 part 解密失败（旧 epoch/根不匹配）"))?;
    Ok((envelope.header, zeroize::Zeroizing::new(plaintext)))
}

/// 读回路径的明文上限：与 `EnvelopeHeader::validate_lengths` 的每类型上限保持一致。
///
/// `fetch_object_inner` 收到的 `total_plain_len` 可能是 relay/其它记录里未按对象类型
/// 校验过的声明，分配前必须按类型收口（ASSET 用 `MAX_ASSET_RAW_BYTES`，其它沿用各自
/// 既有 limits）。
fn max_plaintext_len(object_type: ObjectType) -> u64 {
    match object_type {
        ObjectType::Update => MAX_UPDATE_CDE_BYTES as u64,
        ObjectType::Snapshot => MAX_LORO_SNAPSHOT_BYTES as u64,
        ObjectType::Manifest => MAX_MANIFEST_CDE_BYTES as u64,
        ObjectType::Asset => MAX_ASSET_RAW_BYTES as u64,
        ObjectType::KeySlot => MAX_KEY_SLOT_PLAINTEXT as u64,
    }
}

#[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
fn fetch_object_inner<C: RelayClient>(
    client: &mut C,
    root: &RootSecretV1,
    object_type: ObjectType,
    object_id: &ObjectId,
    part_count: u32,
    total_plain_len: u64,
    expected_digest: &[u8; 32],
    descriptor: &[u8],
    key_override: Option<&crate::keys::Secret32>,
    expected_context: Option<&ExpectedEnvelopeContext>,
) -> Result<(EnvelopeHeader, Vec<u8>), SyncError> {
    // 分配之前先按对象类型与固定切片规则把声明收口。调用方的 `part_count` /
    // `total_plain_len` 可能直接来自 relay 声明（例如 ASSET 日志事件的
    // `ObjectCommit`），而 `Vec::with_capacity(u32::MAX as usize)` 在分配失败时是
    // **abort**（不可捕获），读回层无从 fail-closed。因此这里先验后配：
    // 1) 总长不得超过该类型的明文上限（与 `EnvelopeHeader::validate_lengths` 同口径）；
    // 2) 片数必须等于固定切片规则算出的片数（关系自洽）；
    // 3) 容量申请用 `try_reserve*`，失败映射成可捕获的 `SyncError::Object`。
    if total_plain_len > max_plaintext_len(object_type) {
        return Err(SyncError::Object("读回对象明文超出类型上限"));
    }
    if u64::from(part_count) != part_count_for(total_plain_len, object_type) {
        return Err(SyncError::Object("读回对象分片数与固定切片不符"));
    }
    let mut envelopes = Vec::new();
    envelopes
        .try_reserve_exact(part_count as usize)
        .map_err(|_| SyncError::Object("读回对象分片数超出可分配容量"))?;
    let mut digests = Vec::new();
    digests
        .try_reserve_exact(part_count as usize)
        .map_err(|_| SyncError::Object("读回对象分片数超出可分配容量"))?;
    for index in 0..part_count {
        let bytes = client.part(object_id, index)?;
        let envelope = Envelope::decode(&bytes)?;
        if envelope.header.object_type != object_type
            || envelope.header.object_id != *object_id
            || envelope.header.part_index != index
            || envelope.header.part_count != part_count
            || envelope.header.total_plaintext_len != total_plain_len
            || envelope.header.generation == 0
                && matches!(object_type, ObjectType::Update | ObjectType::Snapshot)
        {
            return Err(SyncError::Object("读回对象 header 不符"));
        }
        // ASSET 来源认证：每一片的 epoch/generation/sender/message/producer 上下文
        // 都必须等于声明，防止 relay 把同 key 的不同声明（或不同代）混片。
        if let Some(expected) = expected_context {
            if envelope.header.vault_id != expected.vault_id
                || envelope.header.key_epoch != expected.key_epoch
                || envelope.header.generation != expected.generation
                || envelope.header.sender_seq != expected.sender_seq
                || envelope.header.message_id != expected.message_id
                || envelope.header.producer_device_id != expected.producer_device_id
            {
                return Err(SyncError::Object("读回对象分片 header 上下文不符"));
            }
        }
        digests.push(Sha256::digest(&bytes).into());
        envelopes.push(envelope);
    }
    let digest_input = object_digest_input(part_count, &digests)?;
    let computed: [u8; 32] = Sha256::digest(&digest_input).into();
    if computed != *expected_digest {
        return Err(SyncError::Object("读回对象摘要不符"));
    }
    let key = match key_override {
        Some(key) => key.clone(),
        None => derive_object_key(root, object_type, object_id)?,
    };
    let cipher = XChaCha20Poly1305::new_from_slice(key.expose_slice())
        .map_err(|_| SyncError::Object("数据密钥长度非法"))?;
    let plaintext_len = usize::try_from(total_plain_len)
        .map_err(|_| SyncError::Object("读回对象明文超出地址空间"))?;
    let mut plaintext = Vec::new();
    plaintext
        .try_reserve(plaintext_len)
        .map_err(|_| SyncError::Object("读回对象明文超出可分配容量"))?;
    for (index, envelope) in envelopes.iter().enumerate() {
        let expected = expected_part_plain_len(
            object_type,
            total_plain_len,
            u32::try_from(index).map_err(|_| SyncError::Object("分片下标溢出"))?,
        )?;
        if envelope.header.this_plaintext_len as usize != expected {
            return Err(SyncError::Object("读回分片长度不符"));
        }
        let aad = envelope.header.aad(descriptor)?;
        let chunk = cipher
            .decrypt(
                XNonce::from_slice(&envelope.header.nonce),
                Payload {
                    msg: &envelope.ciphertext,
                    aad: &aad,
                },
            )
            .map_err(|_| SyncError::Object("读回 AEAD 解密失败"))?;
        plaintext.extend_from_slice(&chunk);
    }
    if plaintext.len() as u64 != total_plain_len {
        return Err(SyncError::Object("读回明文长度不符"));
    }
    let header = envelopes
        .first()
        .map(|envelope| envelope.header.clone())
        .ok_or(SyncError::Object("读回对象没有分片"))?;
    Ok((header, plaintext))
}

/// ADR §31：ASSET 的 header `producer_device_id` 固定为 0（AAD 不含 producer）。
///
/// 其他对象类型保留真实设备 id（它们用随机 nonce，不存在跨设备确定性要求）。
fn asset_producer(object_type: ObjectType, producer_device_id: DeviceId) -> DeviceId {
    if object_type == ObjectType::Asset {
        [0u8; 16]
    } else {
        producer_device_id
    }
}

/// ADR §19：ASSET 的确定性 nonce = `HKDF-SHA256(K_object, salt=vault_id,
/// info = "MN/v1/asset-nonce\\0" || object_id || BE32(part_index), 24)`。
///
/// §31 起 `object_id` 提交完整资产明文头（MIME/长度/数据摘要），所以同一
/// `(object_id, part_index)` 只可能对应同一明文头与同一 AAD。
fn asset_nonce(
    key: &crate::keys::Secret32,
    vault_id: &VaultId,
    object_id: &ObjectId,
    part_index: u32,
) -> Result<[u8; 24], SyncError> {
    let mut info = Vec::with_capacity(crate::domain::HKDF_ASSET_NONCE_INFO.len() + 36);
    info.extend_from_slice(crate::domain::HKDF_ASSET_NONCE_INFO);
    info.extend_from_slice(object_id);
    info.extend_from_slice(&part_index.to_be_bytes());
    let mut nonce = [0u8; 24];
    crate::kdf::hkdf_expand(key.expose_slice(), vault_id, &info, &mut nonce)?;
    Ok(nonce)
}

/// ASSET 的确定性 message_id（ADR §19 要求重传密文字节一致；header 里的 message_id
/// 也参与 AAD，因此必须确定）。取确定性 nonce 派生输入的一个保留 part 序号后前 16B。
pub fn asset_message_id(root: &RootSecretV1, object_id: &ObjectId) -> Result<[u8; 16], SyncError> {
    let key = derive_object_key(root, ObjectType::Asset, object_id)?;
    let nonce = asset_nonce(&key, &root.vault_id, object_id, u32::MAX)?;
    let mut message_id = [0u8; 16];
    message_id.copy_from_slice(&nonce[..16]);
    Ok(message_id)
}

/// KEY_SLOT 的 `context_hash` = `SHA256(CDE(descriptor))`；其他类型全零。
fn context_hash_for(object_type: ObjectType, descriptor: &[u8]) -> Result<[u8; 32], SyncError> {
    if object_type == ObjectType::KeySlot {
        if descriptor.is_empty() {
            return Err(SyncError::Descriptor("KEY_SLOT 缺少 descriptor"));
        }
        Ok(Sha256::digest(descriptor).into())
    } else {
        Ok([0u8; 32])
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    use crate::keys::derive_asset_id_key;
    use crate::test_support::TestRng;
    use hmac::{Hmac, Mac};

    /// §31 之前的旧口径：`object_id = HMAC(K_asset_id, real_sha256)`。
    fn old_object_id(root: &RootSecretV1, real_sha256: &[u8; 32]) -> ObjectId {
        let key = derive_asset_id_key(root).expect("asset id key");
        let mut mac = <Hmac<Sha256> as Mac>::new_from_slice(key.expose_slice()).expect("HMAC key");
        mac.update(real_sha256);
        let digest = mac.finalize().into_bytes();
        let mut out = [0u8; 32];
        out.copy_from_slice(&digest);
        out
    }

    #[test]
    fn old_real_sha_only_id_would_reuse_nonce_for_different_mime() {
        let root = RootSecretV1::generate([0x5a; 16], 1, &mut TestRng::new(7)).expect("root");
        let data = b"same asset bytes";
        let real: [u8; 32] = Sha256::digest(data).into();

        // 旧口径：同字节不同 MIME 撞同一个 object_id → 同一个 K_object → 同一个 nonce。
        let old_a = old_object_id(&root, &real);
        let old_b = old_object_id(&root, &real);
        assert_eq!(old_a, old_b, "旧口径只按 real_sha 必然撞 id");
        let key_old_a = derive_object_key(&root, ObjectType::Asset, &old_a).expect("old key a");
        let key_old_b = derive_object_key(&root, ObjectType::Asset, &old_b).expect("old key b");
        assert_eq!(
            asset_nonce(&key_old_a, &root.vault_id, &old_a, 0).expect("old nonce a"),
            asset_nonce(&key_old_b, &root.vault_id, &old_b, 0).expect("old nonce b"),
            "旧口径下不同 MIME 会复用同一 nonce（灾难性）"
        );
        // 但两个 MIME 的完整资产明文头不同——正是 §31 要修的 nonce 复用。
        let plain_a =
            crate::checkpoint::asset_plaintext(&real, data.len() as u64, "text/plain", data)
                .expect("plaintext a");
        let plain_b = crate::checkpoint::asset_plaintext(
            &real,
            data.len() as u64,
            "application/octet-stream",
            data,
        )
        .expect("plaintext b");
        assert_ne!(plain_a, plain_b);

        // §31 新口径：object_id 提交完整明文头 → 不同 id → 不同 nonce。
        let new_a =
            crate::checkpoint::asset_object_id(&root, &real, data.len() as u64, "text/plain")
                .expect("new id a");
        let new_b = crate::checkpoint::asset_object_id(
            &root,
            &real,
            data.len() as u64,
            "application/octet-stream",
        )
        .expect("new id b");
        assert_ne!(new_a, new_b, "§31：MIME 必须进入 object_id");
        let key_new_a = derive_object_key(&root, ObjectType::Asset, &new_a).expect("new key a");
        let key_new_b = derive_object_key(&root, ObjectType::Asset, &new_b).expect("new key b");
        assert_ne!(
            asset_nonce(&key_new_a, &root.vault_id, &new_a, 0).expect("new nonce a"),
            asset_nonce(&key_new_b, &root.vault_id, &new_b, 0).expect("new nonce b"),
            "不同明文头必须得到不同 nonce"
        );
    }
}
`````
